rows.subgroup: Recipient genotype (all acute leukemia allo-HSCT recipients)
rows.verbatim_source: 1063 A/G (D299G) ... P=0.006 ... Normal genotype 106 / 23 / 10; Carrier recipient 6 / 6 / 3
rows.note: Counts from stacked bar chart (no infection / probable / proven IA). Normal genotype: 106 no infection, 23 probable, 10 proven. Carrier recipient (AG and GG grouped): 6 no infection, 6 probable, 3 proven. Case counts per genotype not printed as totals and carriers group het+hom, so separate counts left null. P-value assignment to the recipient comparison read from the shorter bracket line in the figure; test not explicitly stated (methods mention log-rank). Normal-genotype group composition (recipient and/or donor normal) not clearly defined; group totals (169) exceed 154 patients.

rows.subgroup: Donor genotype (recipients transplanted from carrier donors)
rows.verbatim_source: 1063 A/G (D299G) ... P=0.026 ... Normal genotype 106 / 23 / 10; Carrier donor 7 / 5 / 3
rows.note: Carrier donor group: 7 no infection, 5 probable, 3 proven IA; normal genotype: 106 / 23 / 10. Carriers group het+hom; separate counts null. P-value assigned from the longer bracket spanning to Carrier donor in the figure.

rows.verbatim_source: 1363 C/T (T399I) ... P=0.006 ... Normal genotype 103 / 24 / 10; Carrier donor 7 / 7 / 1

paper_note: Koldehoff 2013 (154 acute leukemia allo-HSCT recipients/donors): IA (probable+proven) by recipient and donor TLR4 D299G/T399I carrier status shown only as bar-chart counts with P-values in Figure 1A/B; no ORs/CIs, no multivariable analysis; the two listed variant entries per SNP are duplicates covered by the same rows.
